verdict.rationale: CDP documents a Sandbox that is a fully isolated test environment for custodial features without real funds (docs-8). It uses the same endpoints, authentication, and response formats as Live (docs-31), and offers magic SSN values for deterministic verification outcomes (docs-32). The evidence does not show which flows the sandbox covers or that test values exist for money movement itself. missing for 10: explicit sandbox coverage of payment acceptance, payouts and conversions/auto-liquidation; deterministic magic values for payment/transfer outcomes (only KYC SSN values are evidenced); independent or hands-on corroboration.
